claim: Independent minimal SPI client tests whether vendor FTS reset/IRQ initialization causes bad identity reads.
oracle: Three split and three single-transfer reads must each return stable 36 48 chip identity; any other bytes are failure, not usable input.

validation.user_journey: No touch action required. Stay in diagnostic console; briefly bind minimal client, capture results, unload and restore supply controls.
code_reasoning: Select existing DT pinctrl; fail on errors
Reset is sole output: raw low100ms then high500ms; IRQ input only
Only FB20000000 read command; no register/firmware/storage writes
Heap buffers; bounded six transactions; probe always returns ENODEV; no input registration
validation.unit: Source command/bounds/error-path checks and W=1 compilation. No mocked hardware success.
validation.end_to_end: Original SPI controller with verified supply hold, host log and watchdog; unload, restore supplies and independently double-read2c/3c; verify USB.

limitations: Chip identity alone cannot establish touch UI
Initial plan serialization failed before device trial; plan repaired and rechecked before loading.
exit_gate: Valid identity and complete rollback before higher-level input work; failures stay experimental.

result.observed: 100ms hardware reset and500ms settle; reset1 IRQ1; all3 split00+02x8; all3 single00fb20000000+02x8
